production_preconditions_confirmed: authenticated had INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER on sales and sale_items
authenticated had TRUNCATE on all six application tables
anon and authenticated had broad direct access to mutation_idempotency
product INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies were tenant-only and did not require admin role
process_product_mutation was invoker-security, had no fixed search_path, had no admin check, and was executable by PUBLIC/anon
complete_sale performed idempotency lookup before auth/tenant and did not exclude soft-deleted products
fn_set_updated_at was directly executable by PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role

changes: Reduced authenticated table ACLs to application-required privileges and removed every client TRUNCATE path
Made sales and sale_items SELECT-only for authenticated clients and deny-only for direct RLS writes
Made mutation_idempotency internal to the hardened RPC
Made product write policies tenant-and-admin scoped while preserving tenant SELECT
Reordered complete_sale to auth -> tenant -> tenant-scoped idempotency -> sale and excluded deleted products
Converted process_product_mutation to SECURITY DEFINER with empty search_path and auth -> tenant -> admin -> idempotency ordering
Closed process_product_mutation EXECUTE to PUBLIC/anon and retained authenticated/service_role
Removed direct client EXECUTE from the trigger-only fn_set_updated_at function

verified_behaviors: anon cannot execute either public mutation RPC
cashier cannot insert/update/delete products or use product mutation RPC
cashier cannot directly insert/update financial records
cross-tenant product reads and idempotency result disclosure are blocked
cashier complete_sale and same-tenant idempotent replay still work
admin direct product insert still works and tenant trigger overrides client tenant input
trigger-only fn_set_updated_at continues to run through product updates

flutter_targeted_tests.observation: Both runs produced no test output or CPU progress and were terminated; no Dart source was changed in this P0 draft.

known_risks_before_production: Any undocumented client or integration that writes sales, sale_items, or mutation_idempotency directly will break and must migrate to the RPC boundary.
Cashier-owned or cross-account offline product mutations will now be rejected; this is intentional but may expose the existing queue user/role-scoping debt.
Soft-deleted products in an offline sale queue will now move to the existing permanent-error/dead-letter path.
service_role still has EXECUTE grants, but both RPCs require a JWT-derived auth.uid; service jobs without user impersonation cannot use these RPCs.
The global products_barcode_key issue is unchanged because it is outside authorization P0 scope.
production_gate: Complete and approve migration-history reconciliation first; do not push while production history and canonical baseline metadata are divergent.
Create a production backup/PITR checkpoint and approved maintenance window.
Inventory every non-Flutter integration for direct financial/idempotency writes.
Resolve or explicitly accept the Flutter test-harness blocker and run targeted client tests.
After deployment run verify_p0_authorization_postconditions.sql, the transactional authorization suite in a safe non-production clone, and admin/cashier smoke tests.
